issues.summary: Show and hide password on the login page
issues.description:
As a customer, I want to tap an eye icon to show my password while I type it, so I make fewer login mistakes.

## Acceptance criteria

- An eye icon in the password field toggles between hidden and shown.
- The password is hidden again after a failed login.
- Works with the keyboard (Tab, Enter).

issues.summary: Balance after transfer is far too high on the receipt
issues.description:
Customer complaint, received by the call center this morning.

## What the customer says

> I moved Rp50.000 from my savings account `******7890` to my friend at Lab Bank. The receipt said my balance after the transfer was **Rp7.495.000.000**. I do not have that much money! My dashboard showed the same big number. When I opened the app again later, it looked normal.

## Details

- Customer user ID: `andi` (demo user)
- Channel: web app
- Transfer: Rp50.000, Lab Bank to Lab Bank (bank code 999), to account `******8901`
- Time: yesterday, during office hours (WIB)
- The customer did not lose money, as far as we know. They are worried and want an answer today.

## Asked by the call center

1. Is the customer's real balance correct?
2. What went wrong, and can it happen to other customers?

comments.author: yoga
comments.body: Customer called again. Please give us something we can tell them.
